server_arguments.name: reasoning_parser
server_arguments.label: reasoning-parser
server_arguments.desc: The parser to use for reasoning.

server_arguments.name: reasoning_config
server_arguments.label: reasoning-config
server_arguments.desc: Configuration for reasoning models. Set reasoning_start_str and reasoning_end_str to the strings that delimit the reasoning block.

server_arguments.name: decode_context_parallel_size
server_arguments.label: decode-context-parallel-size
server_arguments.desc: Number of decode context parallel groups, because the world size does not change by dcp, it simply reuse the GPUs of TP group, and tp_size needs to be divisible by dcp_size.

server_arguments.name: trust_remote_code
server_arguments.label: trust-remote-code
server_arguments.desc: Trust remote code from huggingface

server_arguments.name: runner
server_arguments.label: runner
server_arguments.desc: The type of model runner to use. Each vLLM instance only supports one model runner, even if the same model can be used for multiple types.

server_arguments.name: convert
server_arguments.label: convert
server_arguments.desc: Convert the model using adapters defined in [vllm.model_executor.models.adapters][]. The most common use case is to adapt a text generation model to be used for pooling tasks.

server_arguments.name: dtype
server_arguments.label: dtype
server_arguments.desc: Data type for model weights and activations

server_arguments.name: kv_cache_dtype
server_arguments.label: kv-cache-dtype
server_arguments.desc: Data type for kv cache storage. If “auto”, will use model data type. CUDA 11.8+ supports fp8 (=fp8_e4m3) and fp8_e5m2. ROCm (AMD GPU) supports fp8 (=fp8_e4m3)

server_arguments.name: enable_expert_parallel
server_arguments.label: enable-expert-parallel
server_arguments.desc: Use expert parallelism instead of tensor parallelism for MoE layers.

server_arguments.name: quantization
server_arguments.label: quantization
server_arguments.desc: Method used to quantize the weights. If null, we first check the quantization_config attribute in the model config file. If that is null, we assume the model weights are not quantized and use dtype to determine the data type of the weights.

server_arguments.name: cpu_offload_gb
server_arguments.label: cpu-offload-gb
server_arguments.desc: The space in GiB to offload to CPU, per GPU. Default is 0, which means no offloading. Intuitively, this argument can be seen as a virtual way to increase the GPU memory size. For example, if you have one 24 GB GPU and set this to 10, virtually you can think of it as a 34 GB GPU. Then you can load a 13B model with BF16 weight, which requires at least 26GB GPU memory. Note that this requires fast CPU-GPU interconnect, as part of the model is loaded from CPU memory to GPU memory on the fly in each model forward pass.

server_arguments.name: gpu_memory_utilization
server_arguments.label: gpu-memory-utilization
server_arguments.desc: The fraction of GPU memory to be used for the model executor, which can range from 0 to 1. For example, a value of 0.5 would imply 50% GPU memory utilization. If unspecified, will use the default value of 0.9. This is a per-instance limit, and only applies to the current vLLM instance. It does not matter if you have another vLLM instance running on the same GPU. For example, if you have two vLLM instances running on the same GPU, you can set the GPU memory utilization to 0.5 for each instance.

server_arguments.name: num_gpu_blocks_override
server_arguments.label: num-gpu-blocks-override
server_arguments.desc: If specified, ignore GPU profiling result and use this number of GPU blocks. Used for testing preemption

server_arguments.name: chat_template
server_arguments.label: chat-template
server_arguments.desc: The file path to the chat template, or the template in single-line form for the specified model

server_arguments.name: chat_template_content_format
server_arguments.label: chat-template-content-format
server_arguments.desc: The format to render message content within a chat template

server_arguments.name: max_model_len
server_arguments.label: max-model-len
server_arguments.desc: Model context length. If unspecified, will be automatically derived from the model config.

server_arguments.name: max_num_batched_tokens
server_arguments.label: max-num-batched-tokens
server_arguments.desc: Maximum number of batched tokens per iteration

server_arguments.name: max_num_seqs
server_arguments.label: max-num-seqs
server_arguments.desc: Maximum number of sequences per iteration.

server_arguments.name: max_logprobs
server_arguments.label: max-logprobs
server_arguments.desc: Max number of log probs to return logprobs is specified in SamplingParams

server_arguments.name: max_seq_len_to_capture
server_arguments.label: max-seq-len-to-capture
server_arguments.desc: Maximum sequence length covered by CUDA graphs. When a sequence has context length larger than this, we fall back to eager mode. Additionally for encoder-decoder models, if the sequence length of the encoder input is larger than this, we fall back to the eager mode

server_arguments.name: load_format
server_arguments.label: load-format
server_arguments.desc: The format of the model weights to load

server_arguments.name: scheduling_policy
server_arguments.label: scheduling-policy
server_arguments.desc: The scheduling policy to use. “fcfs” (first come first served, i.e. requests are handled in order of arrival; default) or “priority” (requests are handled based on given priority (lower value means earlier handling) and time of arrival deciding any ties)

server_arguments.name: preemption_mode
server_arguments.label: preemption-mode
server_arguments.desc: If ‘recompute’, the engine performs preemption by recomputing; If ‘swap’, the engine performs preemption by block swapping.

server_arguments.name: enable_chunked_prefill
server_arguments.label: enable-chunked-prefill
server_arguments.desc: If set, the prefill requests can be chunked based on the max_num_batched_tokens.

server_arguments.name: limit_mm_per_prompt
server_arguments.label: limit-mm-per-prompt
server_arguments.desc: For each multimodal plugin, limit how many input instances to allow for each prompt. Expects a comma-separated list of items, e.g.: image=16,video=2 allows a maximum of 16 images and 2 videos per prompt. Defaults to 1 for each modality.

server_arguments.name: disable_mm_preprocessor_cache
server_arguments.label: disable-mm-preprocessor-cache
server_arguments.desc: If true, then disables caching of the multi-modal preprocessor/mapper. (not recommended)

server_arguments.name: scheduler_delay_factor
server_arguments.label: scheduler-delay-factor
server_arguments.desc: Apply a delay (of delay factor multiplied by previous prompt latency) before scheduling next prompt

server_arguments.name: skip_tokenizer_init
server_arguments.label: skip-tokenizer-init
server_arguments.desc: Skip initialization of tokenizer and detokenizer

server_arguments.name: tokenizer_mode
server_arguments.label: tokenizer-mode
server_arguments.desc: “auto” will use the fast tokenizer if available. “slow” will always use the slow tokenizer. “mistral” will always use the mistral_common tokenizer.

server_arguments.name: config_format
server_arguments.label: config-format
server_arguments.desc: “auto” will try to load the config in hf format if available else it will try to load in mistral format

server_arguments.name: enforce_eager
server_arguments.label: enforce-eager
server_arguments.desc: Always use eager-mode PyTorch. If false, will use eager mode and CUDA graph in hybrid for maximal performance and flexibility.

server_arguments.name: max_parallel_loading_workers
server_arguments.label: max-parallel-loading-workers
server_arguments.desc: Load model sequentially in multiple batches, to avoid RAM OOM when using tensor parallel and large models.

server_arguments.name: enable_prefix_caching
server_arguments.label: enable-prefix-caching
server_arguments.desc: Enables automatic prefix caching

server_arguments.name: disable_sliding_window
server_arguments.label: disable-sliding-window
server_arguments.desc: Disables sliding window, capping to sliding window size

server_arguments.name: enable_request_id_headers
server_arguments.label: enable-request-id-headers
server_arguments.desc: If specified, API server will add X-Request-Id header to responses. Caution: this hurts performance at high QPS

server_arguments.name: enable_auto_tool_choice
server_arguments.label: enable-auto-tool-choice
server_arguments.desc: Enable auto tool choice for supported models. Use –-tool-call-parser to specify which parser to use

server_arguments.name: tool_call_parser
server_arguments.label: tool-call-parser
server_arguments.desc: select the tool parser to use. Check: https://docs.vllm.ai/en/stable/features/tool_calling.html#automatic-function-calling . Additional tool parsers will continue to be added in the future, and also can register your own tool parsers in the --tool-parser-plugin

server_arguments.name: tool_parser_plugin
server_arguments.label: tool-parser-plugin
server_arguments.desc: ool parser plugin used to register user defined tool parsers into vllm, the registered tool parser name can be specified in --tool-call-parser

server_arguments.name: disable_fastapi_docs
server_arguments.label: disable-fastapi-docs
server_arguments.desc: Disable FastAPI’s OpenAPI schema, Swagger UI, and ReDoc endpoint

server_arguments.name: enable_prompt_tokens_details
server_arguments.label: enable-prompt-tokens-details
server_arguments.desc: If set to true, enable prompt_tokens_details in usage

server_arguments.name: long_prefill_token_threshold
server_arguments.label: long-prefill-token-threshold
server_arguments.desc: For chunked prefill, a request is considered 'long' if the prompt is longer than this number of tokens

server_arguments.name: speculative_config
server_arguments.label: speculative-config
server_arguments.desc: Speculative Decoding schema to use with vLLM to reduce inter-token latency

arguments.name: temperature
arguments.label: temperature
arguments.desc: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic

arguments.name: top_p
arguments.label: top_p
arguments.desc: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered

arguments.name: top_k
arguments.label: top_k
arguments.desc: The number of highest probability vocabulary tokens to keep for top-k-filtering

arguments.name: max_tokens
arguments.label: max_tokens
arguments.desc: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the chat completion

arguments.name: min_tokens
arguments.label: min_tokens
arguments.desc: The minimum number of tokens to generate in the chat completion

arguments.name: stop
arguments.label: stop_sequences
arguments.desc: Up to 4 sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens

arguments.name: presence_penalty
arguments.label: presence_penalty
arguments.desc: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics

arguments.name: frequency_penalty
arguments.label: frequency_penalty
arguments.desc: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim

arguments.name: thinking_token_budget
arguments.label: thinking_token_budget
arguments.desc: Maximum number of tokens allowed for the model's reasoning/thinking phase. Set to -1 or omit for unlimited.

arguments.name: logit_bias
arguments.label: logit_bias
arguments.desc: Accepts a json object that maps tokens (specified by their token ID in the tokenizer) to an associated bias value from -100 to 100. Mathematically, the bias is added to the logits generated by the model prior to sampling

arguments.name: ignore_eos
arguments.label: ignore_eos
arguments.desc: Whether to ignore the EOS token and continue generating tokens after the EOS token is generated.

arguments.name: use_beam_search
arguments.label: use_beam_search
arguments.desc: Whether to use beam search instead of sampling.

arguments.name: stop_token_ids
arguments.label: stop_token_ids
arguments.desc: List of tokens that stop the generation when they are generated. The returned output will contain the stop tokens unless the stop tokens are special tokens.

arguments.name: skip_special_tokens
arguments.label: skip_special_tokens
arguments.desc: Whether to skip special tokens in the output.

arguments.name: n
arguments.label: n
arguments.desc: number of answers to generate
